reality_delta: The main AI has materially improved the evidence: a safety ceiling limits stale-active deletion and is backed by a dedicated receipt; the public/private boundary scanner now has a negative test showing it can catch private_identity_body markers; OL-06 and OL-08 are explicitly demoted to pending-e2e states rather than being treated as closed; and the open-loop gate still reports closeout_allowed=false. These are concrete state changes, not only new documents.
main_concern: The strongest remaining weakness is self-referential validation: the boundary scanner, the open-loop gate, and the E2E retention proof are all artifacts of the same system under review, and the most load-bearing run proof is still an intentionally aborted run. Without visible scanner rules, visible exit-criteria logic, and a successful full E2E run, the package remains more internally consistent than independently verified.
top_risks: The boundary scanner may be tuned to catch exactly the one negative sample used in self-check; other forms of private content or semantically leaked identity information could pass undetected.

The open-loop exit criteria and the closeout_allowed decision function are not exposed; if they contain discretionary language such as 'agreed with Prism,' the infinite-loop generator risk is merely gated behind a human label.

Retention behavior on a fully successful E2E run—especially the old-successful-run preservation policy—has not been exercised end-to-end; the current proof only exercises the aborted-run cleanup path.
missing_evidence: The boundary scanner's rule set / marker definitions and a broader adversarial test corpus showing it catches multiple forms of private-content leakage, not just private_identity_body.
The exact exit_criteria and the machine logic that determines closeout_allowed in the open-loop queue, so the gate can be audited as objective.
A successful full complete-revival-e2e run that produces redcap-e2e-run-retention-after-run.json on the success path, not only on a test-injected aborted path.
minimum_fix: Publish the scanner rules and the open-loop closeout logic so they can be audited. Run the scanner against a diverse set of deliberately contaminated documents. Keep OL-01 open until a full successful complete-revival-e2e run demonstrates retention behavior on the success path. Once those are provided, this stage can be accepted as a valid partial closure.

anti_loop_signal.reason: The main AI has stopped trying to close OL-06/OL-08 and is now using the open-loop gate to hold them open, which is progress. However, it is still expanding the receipt/self-check inventory each round instead of running the one full E2E success case that the user's intent ultimately requires. That is the loop signal: substituting more internal validation artifacts for an independent end-to-end run.

user_intent_alignment: Mostly aligned in scope: the main AI correctly narrowed this round to stage-level claims and left full E2E blocked by OL-01. It is not aligned in verification depth: the user asked to execute, test, and fix until no new issues, and the current evidence is still dominated by self-generated artifacts rather than an independent success-path demonstration.
